first_step_test: Two page outlines meeting at one central gutter fix the book's width and perspective before small details.

source.notes: Five-panel second generated contact sheet approved after first sheet was rejected for an early leaf-vein step. Raw approved sheet and rejected sheet retained privately.

final_elements.name: left page
final_elements.description: Left open page fans from center gutter to a low outer corner.

final_elements.name: right page
final_elements.description: Right open page mirrors the left with a slightly lifted outer corner.

final_elements.name: page thickness
final_elements.description: Two short lower edges and a lightly curved bottom stack show paper thickness.

final_elements.name: pressed leaf
final_elements.description: One five-lobed maple leaf lies diagonally on the right page, attached to a short stem.

final_elements.name: leaf veins
final_elements.description: One midrib and four side veins stay inside the fixed leaf outline.

final_elements.name: page details
final_elements.description: A few faint parallel page lines and a small broken cast shadow stay subordinate to the leaf.

final_elements.name: fine leaf branches
final_elements.description: A few delicate vein branches inside the fixed five-lobed leaf.

frames.visible_job: Draw two broad page outlines joining at the same center gutter.
frames.instruction: Mark a low center gutter, sweep one page outline left and one right, then bring both lower edges back to the gutter. Keep the right page slightly lifted.

frames.visible_job: Add the visible lower page stack without moving the upper page edges.
frames.instruction: Under each lower page edge, draw a short parallel curve and connect its outside tip to the page above; keep the central gutter in place.

frames.visible_job: Place one five-lobed maple leaf and its veins on the right page.
frames.instruction: On the right page, draw one gently tilted five-lobed maple leaf, its stem toward the lower gutter, then add a central midrib and four light side veins. Leave clear paper between leaf tips and page edges.

frames.visible_job: Add two left-page lines, fine leaf branches, and a broken shadow beneath the book.
frames.instruction: Add two short, faint parallel lines on the open left page, a few fine vein branches within the leaf, and a broken horizontal shadow beneath the page stack. Keep all five leaf lobes visible.

final_step.visible_job: Shade established page folds, leaf and ground without adding structure.
final_step.instruction: Glaze the existing leaf with muted russet and ochre pencil, deepen the gutter and ground shadow with soft graphite, and keep the page faces mostly white.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop contains only two broad page faces joined at a low center gutter; its simple outline fixes width and page placement for a beginner.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: All five saved crops were read in order. Left and right page corners, central gutter, lower stack, single five-lobed leaf and stem keep their anchors. No temporary guides appear; the finish colors and shades contours already taught.

transitions.observed_addition: The two page faces and central gutter stay fixed; thin lower stack curves appear below both original lower edges.
transitions.instruction_match: The second instruction describes parallel lower edges, matching the new stack without redrawing the page faces.

transitions.observed_addition: Both page faces and the lower stack persist; one five-lobed leaf and its stem appear on the right page, with a midrib and four major vein paths.
transitions.instruction_match: The third instruction places the whole leaf and its major veins within the existing right page.

transitions.observed_addition: The book and five leaf lobes remain; two short lines appear on the left page, fine vein branches appear inside the leaf, and a broken shadow appears below the stack.
transitions.instruction_match: The fourth instruction names the left-page lines, subtle internal veins, and ground shadow visible in this crop.

transitions.observed_addition: The page corners, gutter, stack, two left-page lines, five-lobed leaf, stem and existing shadow remain; russet and ochre fill the leaf while graphite deepens the fold and ground.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction calls for color and shading on established geometry; no new structural contour appears.
